name: Moonlit
source:
We grow and change bit by bit every day. Nothing stays the same, but how much control do we really have? 

Two childhood friends have to grapple with these thoughts as they spend one night discovering new things about each other in the time they spent apart.

Come along with Sam the otter and Robby the wolf through a short story about friendship, loneliness, and change.

[From [url=https://buffbuck.itch.io/moonlit-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
